{{ Effects remain until removed by specific methods/time

{{ Timed-Out: can't do anything during your next turn.*

{{{{{{ Timed-Out III: can't do anything during your next 3 turns.*
*Timed-Out can be obtained if you are being a bit too overpowered, e.g. healing and dealing 2 damage in the same turn.

|| Confused: turn ends immediately. CAN'T BLOCK NEXT ATTACK!
|| Trip: turn ends immediately, but takes half damage during opponent's next turn.

{{ Anger: strong attacks x2 stronger, but might turn into rage.
{{{{ Rage: strong attacks x2 stronger, but takes x2 damage.

|| Relaxed: cures from all Orange/Purple effects. Obtained when executing 1 or fewer attacks per turn, for a while.
|| Cure: when healing.

{{ Critical: weak-point, the next hit you receive will be 2 times stronger.
|| Weak: deal x0.5 damage until your turn is over.

|| Insanity: once during your turn, you can deplete all the opponent's HP by attacking.**
**Preferably use it only when you are surely to win and want to end the fight in a smug, flashy way.
|| Full Healing: recovers all HP. Can be used for going into a new Phase with no problem (unless Phases are banned).
